citations.quote: c Judge the suitability of investments in the context of the client’s total portfolio.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard III.C REQUIRES reasonable inquiry into client objectives/constraints and suitability of investments in the context of the client's total portfolio; III.D requires fair, accurate, complete performance disclosure (GIPS recommended); III.E requires client-information confidentiality subject to legal disclosure overrides.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard III(C) Suitability + III(D) Performance Presentation + III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality
